content.rendered:
Though outwardly we are wasting away, inwardly we are being renewed day by day. The outer is fading. The inner is being made new. The Spirit is doing both simultaneously.

The Gospel For Today | Saturday, June 6, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.”
2 Corinthians 4:16 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul tells the Corinthians something every believer eventually has to come to terms with. The outer is wasting away. The body gets tired. The years take their toll. The skin loses its softness. The energy that used to feel infinite begins to feel measured. None of this is failure. All of it is the simple truth of being a mortal creature in a fallen world. Paul does not deny it. He looks it in the eye.

And then he gives the other half of the truth, the half that the world cannot see and only the Spirit makes real. Inwardly, we are being renewed day by day. The inner person, the part of you that will outlast your body, the part of you that is being conformed to the image of Christ, is not aging. It is getting younger. Stronger. Brighter. More alive. The Spirit who indwells you is renewing that inner person, every day, in ways that often only show up on your face years later.

This is one of the great hidden glories of the Christian life. While the body is doing what bodies do, the soul under the Spirit’s care is doing the opposite. Anxiety that used to dominate has begun to lose its grip. Forgiveness that used to feel impossible has become familiar. Love for people who used to irritate you has crept in without you noticing. Worship has started to come more easily. Scripture has started to come alive in places it used to feel dry. None of that is your achievement. It is the renewal of the inner person the Spirit is doing every single day you have walked with Christ.

Paul knew what he was talking about. He had been beaten, shipwrecked, imprisoned, hungry, cold, and at the time he wrote this letter, he was likely in his fifties and showing every mile of his apostolic journey. And he was the same man who could write that he had learned to be content in every circumstance, that his life would be poured out as a drink offering with joy. The outer was wasting. The inner was being made glorious.

So do not lose heart. Whatever the body is doing today, whatever the mirror says, the part of you that lasts forever is in the hands of the Spirit, and He is making it new. The tiredness is real. The renewal is also real. And the renewal is winning.

Prayer

Father, thank You that what is wasting in me is not the part of me that matters most. Thank You that Your Spirit is renewing my inner person every single day. Today, when I am tempted to focus on what is fading, lift my eyes to what is being made new. Make me strong on the inside, where it counts forever. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I do not lose heart. Though outwardly I am wasting away, inwardly I am being renewed day by day. The Spirit of God is at work in my inner person. What is eternal in me is growing. What is fading in me is not the truest thing about me.
